theme:ai-power.value: 2026-10-29 Power demand from the AI build looks intact: Microsoft guided over $50 billion of capex next quarter and $170 billion for 2027, and Alphabet will spend more in 2027 than its $195 to $205 billion 2026 plan (CNBC, Reuters). Baker Hughes, which sells gas turbines for data centers, still fell 7.36% on Oct 28 after a Q3 beat because the Middle East war cut oilfield service demand (Seeking Alpha, Investing.com).
theme:ai-power.was: 2026-10-28 GE Vernova reported Q3 on Oct 28: orders of $29.3 billion, up 96% organically, with Power orders up 178%, a backlog of $197 billion that it expects to pass $200 billion in Q4, and gas turbine backlog plus slot reservations up from 116 to 122 GW, heading to at least 130 GW by year end. It raised 2026 guidance and its buyback (company release); it booked 16.6 GW of gas turbines in the quarter against 7.4 GW a year ago (10-Q via StockTitan).

theme:robotics-automation.value: 2026-10-29 ARK bought Teradyne in ARKK, ARKQ and ARKX on Oct 28, about 0.25% of each fund (ARK email). AGCO is running Agility Robotics humanoids at its Hesston, Kansas plant, and Schaeffler has humanoids building actuator parts for other humanoids in China (engineering.com, Oct 28).
theme:robotics-automation.was: 2026-10-22 Tesla said on its Oct 21 call that Optimus production has started on high volume lines in Fremont, with Musk warning the early ramp will be slow and bumpy, and that it aims to deliver the first Cybercab robotaxis to customers by Dec 31 and launch in Dallas next month. It also cut 2026 capex to about $20 billion from more than $25 billion. Q3 adjusted EPS was $0.48 against about $0.43 expected, but the stock fell about 3% to 5% premarket.

theme:critical-materials.value: 2026-10-29 Lynas lifted first quarter revenue 55% to A$310.1 million on record realised prices of A$102.1 per kg, with floor price contracts covering over half its sales, but flagged shutdowns at its Malaysia and Kalgoorlie plants (IndexBox, Oct 29). Lula's win keeps Brazil's push to refine its own rare earths; Brazil holds the second largest reserves, but Benchmark sees no domestic refining until 2030 (Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, Oct 28).
theme:critical-materials.was: 2026-10-17 China's September rare earth exports rose 6.7% from a year ago to 4,269.8 tonnes, though January to September exports are still down 9.6% (SMM). On Oct 15 China's commerce ministry said it will keep easing rare earth export licenses for the EU and wants the same treatment on dual use cases. US producers fell: MP 3.5% to 40.17 and USAR 5.0% to 10.54 on Oct 16 (dashboard).

theme:defense-reshoring.value: 2026-10-29 Boeing sold off for a second day on 2.67 times normal volume (BA 167.14 on Oct 28, Massive) after pushing its 737 ramp into 2027. Its defense unit's operating profit rose to $492 million from $114 million, but a $252 million gain on the HRL Laboratories stake drove much of it, and the F/A-XX award is not yet in backlog (Air Data News, Oct 28).
theme:defense-reshoring.was: 2026-10-28 Boeing fell 10.69% to 168.18 on Oct 27, a 52 week low, on 6.73 times its 50 day volume, after a core loss of $0.34 a share against $0.21 expected and a delay of its 737 ramp: 47 a month only in early 2027 and 52 in the second half (Vantage citing CNBC and Reuters, Massive). Jefferies says Boeing expects about $3 billion of free cash flow next year against a $5.5 billion consensus.

theme:space-quantum-cyber.value: 2026-10-29 Fortinet fell 25.7% premarket on Oct 29 after its Q3: results beat, but product growth of 37% missed the roughly 50% the market wanted and it cut its service revenue guide to $5.15 billion to $5.17 billion; BofA downgraded it to Neutral with a $140 target, and an unconfirmed breach report added pressure (Investing.com). Palo Alto, Zscaler and CrowdStrike fell in sympathy.
theme:space-quantum-cyber.was: 2026-10-24 Cybersecurity bounced back from last week's downgrade sell off: on Oct 23 CRWD rose 8.2% to 257.57 and PANW 7.2% to 380.55 (dashboard), after Deutsche Bank named Palo Alto one of three companies placed to gain from rising AI use and a newly found software flaw that could affect a large share of websites put defense spending back in focus (Motley Fool, Oct 23). CRWD is up about 13% from its Oct 16 close of 227.39.

theme:healthcare-medtech.value: 2026-10-29 BLCO jumped 15.78% to 20.40 on Oct 28 on 8.93 times its 50 day volume after its Q3 beat and raise, a heavy volume breakout above its 17.76 prior high (Massive). Boston Scientific fell another 5.84% that day after missing estimates (Investing.com). WST reported Q3 adjusted EPS of $2.66 against $2.20 expected and raised its outlook (StockStory, RTTNews).
theme:healthcare-medtech.was: 2026-10-28 Bausch + Lomb reported Q3 on Oct 28: revenue $1.38 billion, up 7.3%, adjusted EPS $0.34 against $0.22 expected, surgical revenue $234 million against $215 million a year ago, operating cash flow $233 million against $137 million, and 2026 revenue guidance raised to about $5.50 billion at the midpoint. Boston Scientific's adjusted EPS of $0.73 missed by $0.02 on revenue up only 1.5% to $5.14 billion (Business Wire, StockStory, Investing.com).

theme:ai-compute.value: 2026-10-29 The big spenders reported and did not slow down. Microsoft's Azure grew 48% and it guided $170 billion of capex for calendar 2027; Alphabet kept $195 to $205 billion for 2026 and said 2027 will rise significantly, while its cloud backlog reached $561 billion (CNBC, Reuters). Samsung's chip division earned 106.5 trillion won, said HBM is sold out for next year and raised chip capex 62% (CNBC, Reuters). Oracle rose 10.73% on Oct 28 after promising positive cash flow in the second half of fiscal 2028. Investors split on cash: Alphabet fell about 10% premarket on $9.1 billion of negative free cash flow.
theme:ai-compute.was: 2026-10-28 SK hynix reported record Q3 results on Oct 28: revenue 104.6 trillion won, up 328%, and operating profit 83.3 trillion won against 76.7 trillion expected, an 80% margin. It said 14 major customers signed long term deals covering more than 50% of its 2027 and 2028 capacity and plans about 100 trillion won of shareholder returns; the shares rose 10.89% in Seoul and Micron was up 4% premarket (CNBC, Reuters).

theme:glp1-obesity.value: 2026-10-29 Lilly's Q3 revenue rose 39% to $24.4 billion on Mounjaro and Zepbound, and it raised 2026 revenue guidance to $91 billion to $92 billion from $85 billion to $87 billion; the stock was up over 5% premarket (company release, Quartz, TradingKey). West Pharmaceutical, which makes the pen and vial components, beat and raised 2026 guidance to $3.41 billion to $3.42 billion of sales (RTTNews).
theme:glp1-obesity.was: 2026-10-27 On Oct 26 a US judge refused Novo Nordisk's request to block Eli Lilly's ads claiming Zepbound beats Wegovy and Mounjaro beats Ozempic, finding no proof of irreparable harm; Novo's lawsuit continues (Reuters via Investing.com, Bloomberg). Lilly already leads in obesity drug sales.

theme:fintech-crypto-rails.value: 2026-10-29 ARK bought Robinhood in ARKK, ARKW and ARKF on Oct 28 while HOOD fell 3.31% to 91.43 after its Q3 miss (ARK email, Massive). Bitcoin slipped below $80,000 on Oct 29 after the Fed's hawkish hold (FXStreet), which keeps pressure on trading driven revenue at HOOD and COIN.
theme:fintech-crypto-rails.was: 2026-10-28 SoFi beat and raised its 2026 outlook and closed up 13.42% at 16.40 on Oct 27 (Yahoo Finance, Massive). Visa's fiscal Q4 adjusted EPS was $3.48 on revenue of $12.1 billion, up 13%, roughly in line, and it was down 1.7% premarket Oct 28; Robinhood fell 8% premarket after its Q3 profit missed, with crypto still in a slump (company release, Reuters). PayPal closed up 2.0% at 56.09 on 1.60 times its 50 day volume the day after its report (Massive).

industry:agriculture-food.value: 2026-10-29 Rechecked on the daily rotation. AGCO's Q3 (Oct 29) sales fell 8.6% to $2.26 billion, with Latin America down 19.1% and Brazil tractor retail sales down 17% for nine months; it kept its 2026 outlook and targets $2 billion of PTx retrofit sales by 2029 from about $1 billion this year. About 29% of global urea trade normally passes Hormuz (S&P Global), which keeps the cost case for nitrogen-fixing biologicals alive. No stage moves: the PRRS pig still waits on Mexico and Japan, and Corteva reports Nov 11.
industry:agriculture-food.was: 2026-10-17 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Deere announced next generation perception autonomy kits in early October for tractors and tillage, orchard sprayers, and landscape and construction machines, and AGCO's Oct 6 Tech Day showed PTx retrofit autonomy for mixed fleets. Corteva set its first crop protection only report for Nov 11 after the close. Perfect Day now targets first commercial whey deliveries from India in Q1 2027. No stage moves: these are product launches, not new revenue.

industry:communications.value: 2026-10-24 On Oct 23 reports said SpaceX is seeking cell tower sites for a mobile carrier service, building on its roughly $8 billion purchase of 800 MHz spectrum from Grain Management earlier in October. Crown Castle rose about 9% to 85.97 and American Tower about 4% to 188.97, while AT&T fell 8.0% to 20.93 on 2.4 times normal volume and T-Mobile 7.7% to 146.54 (Motley Fool midday, Oct 23; dashboard and Yahoo Finance closes).
industry:communications.was: 2026-10-16 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Ericsson's Q3 (Oct 15) showed sales of SEK 59.5 billion against 56.2 billion a year ago, 7% organic growth led by Networks, and net income down to about SEK 5.8 billion because last year included a divestment gain. It still sees a flat radio market in 2026 and rising AI driven component costs. The ERIC ADR jumped 11.8% to 10.71 on about 4.5 times normal volume. Amazon had almost 400 Leo satellites up as of Oct 9; AST has not yet dated its next launch.

industry:consumer.value: 2026-10-18 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Dexcom set Q3 results for Oct 29 after the close and Hims for Nov 9; Abbott reports Oct 21. The FDA panel on Sydnexis's SYD-101 myopia drop is still set for Oct 30, and Oura has not set a new IPO date since postponing on Sep 29. No stage moves: these are dates, not new revenue or approvals.

industry:defense-security.value: 2026-10-19 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Drone Dominance Gauntlet II orders have started (Neros 14,000 drones for over $100 million, Swarm Defense 4,000 for at least $25 million), the Army now expects its first LOCUST X3 laser by Q4 FY2027 and combat use by early 2028, and the Senate leader signaled no new Golden Dome reconciliation money before the midterms. No stage moves: orders are small next to the 60,000 drone plan.

industry:energy.value: 2026-10-23 Bloom Energy's Q3 (Oct 22) showed behind the meter power is selling: product revenue crossed $1 billion for the first time ($1.07 billion, up 179%), total revenue rose 138% to $1.24 billion, and 2026 revenue guidance rose to $4.4 to $4.6 billion. The catch is cash: the quarter used $181 million of free cash flow as inventory and receivables grew.
industry:energy.was: 2026-10-20 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Behind the meter power keeps adding real orders: LS Electric booked $138.5 million of switchgear for Bloom fuel cells at a Pennsylvania data center, likely Aligned's Project Phoenix where Bloom may supply up to 2 GW (DCD). Fervo's Cape Station is running and it is hosting an investor open house, while JPMorgan cut its target to $27 on Oct 19. Small reactor stocks hit new lows on a Barclays downgrade of NuScale (Oct 20). No stage moves.

industry:financials.value: 2026-10-27 SoFi launched SOFIE on Oct 22, which it calls the first national bank issued tokenized deposit for consumers: each token is $1 on deposit at SoFi Bank, FDIC insured, paying 4.40% APY, and can be converted 1:1 into its SoFiUSD stablecoin, which ends the yield and the insurance (SoFi, The Block). Rollout to its crypto customers finishes in November.
industry:financials.was: 2026-10-24 The OCC finalized its GENIUS Act stablecoin rule on Oct 21, 2026, the first agency to finish its part, setting federal standards for licensing, reserves, redemptions, audits and custody ahead of the law's Jan 18, 2027 start. Existing issuers that file a complete application in time can get waivers of up to 12 months, but no application window is open until OMB approves the forms. Rechecked on the daily rotation: Upstart confirmed Q3 results for Nov 3, and DTCC's October tokenization launch is not yet confirmed.

industry:healthcare.value: 2026-10-29 Lilly's Q3 revenue rose 39% to $24.4 billion, driven by Mounjaro and Zepbound, and it raised 2026 revenue guidance to $91 billion to $92 billion from $85 billion to $87 billion, its third raise this year (company release, Quartz). West Pharmaceutical, which supplies pen and vial components, also beat and raised.
industry:healthcare.was: 2026-10-21 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Intuitive's Q3 (Oct 20) showed revenue of $3.05 billion, up 22%, and about 14% da Vinci procedure growth, but US procedures grew only 10% against 20% abroad. It plans extended use instruments and other price moves that cut instrument revenue per case 3% to 5% by the end of 2027, and took a $450 million antitrust settlement charge. The stock traded near $406 after hours from 438.00. Gene editing (lonvo-z decision March 10, 2027), AI diagnostics (Medicare fee schedule final rule due early November) and brain implants had no new milestone; no FDA action on CagriSema has been reported.

industry:industrials.value: 2026-10-26 Tesla said on its Oct 21 call that early Optimus production has started on a Fremont line built for about 1 million robots a year, that reaching about 20,000 a week will take at least a year, and that it plans to sell to outside companies around the end of 2027, with its AI5 chip in Optimus around April 2027. Stage stays pilot: output is for internal use and there are no outside orders yet.
industry:industrials.was: 2026-10-13 Symbotic announced on Oct 13 that it is buying cellumation, a Bremen sortation company whose software driven floor replaces fixed conveyors. At the same time a Wall Street Journal report says Walmart's warehouse automation keeps hitting breakdowns and that Symbotic does not expect a workable in store pickup model until 2028, which pushes out the 400 store option.

industry:materials.value: 2026-10-27 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Hexcel reported Q3 on Oct 21: sales about $496 million, up 8.8%, adjusted EPS $0.50 against $0.37, commercial aerospace up about 21% and defense and space down about 9%. It kept 2026 guidance, but shares fell about 11% to 12% as sales missed the roughly $502 million forecast (SEC filing, Investing.com).
industry:materials.was: 2026-10-14 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Hexcel confirmed it will report Q3 results on Oct 21 after the close, with the call Oct 22; third party calendars showing Oct 26 or Oct 28 are wrong. MP Materials still guides first commercial magnet shipments to GM for Q4 2026, with no shipment date announced.

industry:space.value: 2026-10-28 Rechecked on the daily rotation. SpaceX's Q3 2026 report (Oct 20) showed revenue of $14.6 billion, up 161%, and net income of $4.4 billion, and called Flight 14 its first revenue generating Starship mission; but its rocket business lost $7 million in the quarter and $1.21 billion in nine months, so Starlink and AI carry the profit. SpaceX says Flight 15 will try to catch both the booster and the ship; no date is confirmed. Rocket Lab pushed Neutron's first launch to 2027 on Oct 14 over tank defects (Reuters). RKLB closed up 8.34% at 58.31 on Oct 27 (Massive).
industry:space.was: 2026-10-15 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Starship Flight 14 (Sep 28) was the first to reach orbit and deployed all 26 Starlink V3 satellites, though a vacuum engine failed and the stay in orbit was cut short; Flight 15 is penciled for no earlier than Oct 19 but not confirmed. SpaceX was reported Oct 6 to 7 to be seeking about $40 billion of debt to buy Nvidia chips. Planet Labs stock is down about 66% from its May peak even with record revenue, as money rotates to SpaceX and rates rise.

industry:technology.value: 2026-10-29 Marvell is in advanced talks to buy Lumentum, a maker of lasers for data center optics, with a deal possibly announced next week (Reuters, Oct 28). If it closes, a major chip designer would own a key laser supplier for optical links, including co-packaged optics. MRVL fell over 11% and LITE rose over 6% premarket Oct 29 (TradingKey). The stage does not change: this is a deal, not new revenue.
industry:technology.was: 2026-10-22 Meta narrowed 2026 capex to $135 to $145 billion but gave no 2027 number and had about negative $2.1 billion of free cash flow in Q3 (Oct 21). The inference build is still growing, but the biggest buyer now spends more than it earns, so 2027 budgets are the test.

industry:transportation.value: 2026-10-23 Rechecked on the daily rotation. On its Oct 21 call Tesla said its Austin Cybercab fleet grew about 10 times since the early September launch, neared 2 million cumulative unsupervised miles, and should reach Dallas next month, with first customer Cybercab deliveries targeted by end of 2026. It also cut 2026 capex to about $20 billion. The FAA drone rule (Part 108) is still at White House review past its Oct 8 window, and neither Joby nor Archer has confirmed a paying passenger.
industry:transportation.was: 2026-10-12 Waymo closed a $5 billion term loan, upsized from about $3 billion and priced at 5.25 points over the benchmark rate, to expand its fleet in the US and abroad. Lenders funding robotaxis is a sign the business is moving from research to fleet operations.

country:argentina.value: 2026-10-23 Argentina's country risk rose to 709 points on Oct 22 and the official dollar sold at a nominal record 1,550 pesos at Banco Nacion (wholesale 1,528), while the Merval fell 1.5% to 97,993 as the tech sell off hit ADRs (Rio Times).
country:argentina.was: 2026-10-17 Pampa Energia director and 10% owner Marcos Mindlin bought about $35.1 million of PAM ADRs at $80.78 on Oct 15 (filed Oct 16), on top of buys by two vice presidents in late September; the insider cluster is about $42.7 million. PAM closed at 81.10 on Oct 16, up 0.8% (dashboard).

country:brazil.value: 2026-10-29 Day three of the post election sell off: the Ibovespa fell 2.68% to 171,006.10 on Oct 28 while the dollar slipped 0.19% to R$5.34 (InfoMoney, UOL). US closes on Oct 28: EWZ 33.62 (down 1.98% on 2.08 times normal volume), NU 11.97 (down 3.47%), ITUB 7.40, BBD 2.73 (down 6.19%), PBR 22.03, MELI 1673.09 (Massive). AGCO reported Brazil tractor retail sales down 17% in the first nine months of 2026.
country:brazil.was: 2026-10-28 Day two after the election crash: the Ibovespa slipped 0.51% to 175,710.05 on Oct 27 and the dollar fell 0.97% to R$5.3506 (Money Times). Citi moved Banco do Brasil to sell, citing farm loan quality and political risk (UOL). US closes on Oct 27: EWZ 34.30 (up 0.44% on 2.16 times normal volume), NU 12.40 (down 1.51%), ITUB 7.67, BBD 2.91, PBR 22.30, MELI 1680.51 (Massive).

country:china.value: 2026-10-29 The yuan rose to 6.6620 per dollar on Oct 29, a four year high, after the Fed's hold; it is up about 5% against the dollar this year and the midpoint was fixed at 6.7147 (Reuters via Economic Times).
country:china.was: 2026-10-22 China's CSI 300 entered a bear market on Oct 22, closing 20.2% below its June 22 peak after 10 straight weekly losses, its first since 2020. Analysts pointed to doubts about AI returns and a deadline on Beijing's push to tax offshore trusts, which may have pushed some large holders to sell.

country:europe.value: 2026-10-28 The euro fell to a 17 month low against the dollar on Oct 28 as the dollar hit a two week high and French fiscal concerns lingered; the exact level was not found. UBS's Q3 net profit of $2.69 billion missed the $2.71 billion consensus, and the ECB approved Intesa Sanpaolo's 31.4 billion euro takeover of Monte dei Paschi (Dow Jones via Morningstar).
country:europe.was: 2026-10-24 Moody's kept France at Aa3 with a negative outlook on Oct 23, sparing it the cut to A1 most analysts expected (AFP via Euronext, Bloomberg). It warned that more evidence of weaker capacity in parliament to stop a steep rise in debt costs would likely lead to a downgrade, and it assumes a 2027 budget is approved; the revenue vote is set for Nov 3.

country:gulf.value: 2026-10-29 Brent settled up 1.3% at $115.32 on Oct 28, then fell 1.73% to $113.32 on Oct 29 after Vice President Vance reached out to Iran's Security Council chief and Qatar offered a new proposal; a senior Iranian official rejected it (CNBC, The National). Baker Hughes fell 7.36% on Oct 28 as the conflict cut oilfield service demand.
country:gulf.was: 2026-10-28 The Houthis claimed a ballistic missile strike on Saudi Arabia's 550,000 barrel a day Ras Tanura refinery; details are disputed (OilPrice). The WSJ reported the US told several Gulf states to prepare for a short, intense military campaign against Iran after the Nov 3 midterms. Brent rose 1.9% to $116.03 early Oct 28 after settling at $113.88 on Oct 27 (Dow Jones via Morningstar, WSJ).

country:india.value: 2026-10-29 The Sensex rose 905.01 points to 74,151.04 and the Nifty 1.05% to 22,936.75 on Oct 29 after the Fed held, led by banks and consumer stocks (Deccan Herald); the rupee closed at 95.25 per dollar (Economic Times). Brent easing toward $113 helps an oil importer.
country:india.was: 2026-10-19 On Oct 16 Trump waived the Graham Act's tariffs of up to 100% on the top five buyers of Russian crude, two days before they took effect. India is one of the largest buyers, so the threat of a new US tariff on top of the 10% Section 301 rate is gone for now, and Brent fell about 2% to $107.60 on Oct 19, which helps an oil importer.

country:japan.value: 2026-10-29 The Nikkei rose 1.1% to 64,659.25 on Oct 29, a fourth straight gain, while Korea fell, as SoftBank and Kioxia rose (TradingKey). The dollar climbed back above 158 yen before the BOJ's Oct 30 decision, which FXStreet previews as a hawkish hold.
country:japan.was: 2026-10-23 The Nikkei fell about 2.7% on Oct 22 as Tokyo Electron, SoftBank Group and Kioxia were sold with US chips, then slipped 0.34% to 62,693.16 on Oct 23, down from 64,621.24 on Oct 21 (CNBC).

country:mexico.value: 2026-10-13 The peso rebounded 0.73% to about 18.26 per dollar on Oct 12 after last week's slide to its weakest since November 2025. September inflation rose to 3.45% a year from 3.26%, a bit under the 3.47% forecast. Banxico's next decision is Nov 5 at 6.50%.
